reading_rule: Complete selected scientific source values, with custody-only fields removed as documented. Author-state tokens remain dated source history; original later qualification governs scientific acceptance.

common.F019_forward: A reduced search over this particular computation/model is admissible only if the reduction preserves its named native predicate, relevant branches, observation distinctions and any required weights/fairness. The specified semantic near-miss identifies a distinction that cannot be erased merely to reduce work. No reduction or efficiency result is claimed to have run.
common.F019_reverse: The native value/predicate and actual computational facet select which state/path distinctions or equivalent cases may be merged, and which omissions would change the result. They permit the unreduced small calculation when reduction adds no benefit; they do not prove a proposed reduction sound.
common.F024_forward: A SAT/SMT encoding of the stated finite or restricted logical/arithmetic predicate can supply a witness or valid absence result at its actual theory/status. Correspondence to this computation and the native predicate is required. UNKNOWN, unsupported arithmetic or a model after UNKNOWN cannot receive proved-SAT/UNSAT credit.
common.F024_reverse: The native predicate and this actual computation identify the formula, domain, values, machine-arithmetic/real-arithmetic distinction and relevant exclusions the solver claim must cover. They do not make a solver reliable or validate two solvers sharing the same wrong formula.
common.F025_forward: A feasible symbolic path through this named computation/model operation can expose a violated stated predicate or a discriminating admitted input. It supports the represented path and environment/library semantics. Incomplete absence, artificial impossible responses and unmodeled paths cannot establish a universal claim.
common.F025_reverse: The actual native computational predicate determines which branches, inputs, environment returns and postconditions are consequential. It supplies the criterion for a useful witness and the completeness domain for absence, without pretending a model path is an observed deployment failure.
common.F026_forward: An actual analyzer result for this named program/model facet contributes only under its supported language subset, property, abstraction, configuration and result interpretation. A useful heuristic warning and a sound restricted absence claim are different outcomes; deliberate escapes and implementation bugs are separate limitations.
common.F026_reverse: The native computation and required predicate determine which supported operations, external calls, state changes and exclusions matter to this analysis result. A narrower useful witness or theorem remains creditable while a broader application remains open.
common.F033_forward: For a compiled implementation of this exact computational facet, a matching compiler-preservation theorem can carry the proved source behavior to its covered target endpoint. This is a conditional implementation-correspondence contribution. The currently inspected Python case execution receives no CompCert or other verified-compiler credit: a supported source implementation, its relation to this facet, the real compiler/version/options and target artifacts would have to be supplied for such execution/application credit.
common.F033_reverse: The native value/predicate and specific computational facet identify the source behavior and observations the compiler theorem must preserve. They can expose an unsupported language, omitted runtime/link stage or timing/quantity extension. They neither instantiate a compiler theorem for Python nor prove a source implementation correct.
common.F034_forward: A per-run validator of the actual representation/implementation transformation used for this facet can check its required value/observation relation without proving every transformer run correct. At the bounded model level a direct input/output relation check may be sufficient. This is explicitly a methodological extension beyond compiler-only examples where a history/table/result representation is the transformation object, not an assertion that those examples were compiler builds.
common.F034_reverse: The native predicate and computational facet select the exact input/output identities and preserved observation/value relation the validator must check. They reject merely equal shapes, a wrong unit/denominator, a pruned decisive branch or a different artifact; they do not establish validator correctness or turn unsupported/rejected validation into proof of a bad transformation.
common.actual_member_test: Each member names an actual inspected computation or previously executed analytical model used as a partial input to its native scientific question. Its exact native value/predicate, formal activity, comparator, residual and consequential near-miss remain bound. The contribution concerns that specific facet, not a generic encoding of the property text or an assertion that the whole receiver is proved.
common.language_and_numeric_guard: The source examples are Python finite models/calculations. Any symbolic/static/compiled/validated treatment needs explicit semantics for the operations it uses, including arbitrary versus bounded integers, Fraction, dictionaries/sets, exceptions, nondeterministic/environment behavior and numerical functions. exp/log/erf/sqrt are not silently linear-SMT terms or exact floating operations. A supported Boolean/finite/arithmetic subclaim may be useful without covering the full function.
common.compiler_boundary: No selected case is relabeled a verified compiler run. F/C11 is abstract allowed/target behavior sets and byte labels; it demonstrates a relation/scope control only. A source-to-target preservation theorem must cover the actual observations required by the native claim, and ordinary trace inclusion need not preserve every probability, timing or relational property. NX04 supplies both the subset-closed positive case and the non-downward-closed countercase.
common.quantitative_boundary: Correct program/model computation does not establish field probabilities, ascertainment, physical renewal, stress mechanisms, operational profiles, effective intervention or normative authority. These remaining premises are not a reason to erase the real computational input.
common.actual_controls: F/C06 distinguishes complete finite exploration, bounded absence and an actual expansion-budget UNKNOWN. F/C09 checks a finite SAT witness/refutation and shows the integer/uint8 encoding difference; the two author algorithms share Python and their encoding. F/C19 explicitly omits unsafe_escape and misses value3; it is a constructed tool-model escape, not a newly found production defect. NX08 exposes a same-shaped wrong history transformation.
common.cost_alternatives: Use the inspected direct evaluator, ordinary deterministic test, exact small unreduced model, human algebraic proof or unchanged sufficient component when adequate. Add only the method scope that resolves a consequential distinction; no mandatory solver/compiler/analyzer/validator pipeline or empirical speedup is asserted.
common.execution: All relations here are own exposed analytical method-to-facet correspondences. No new solver, analyzer, symbolic engine, compiler, validator or scientific case program executes. All actual case results retain their original constituent[custody locator omitted; scientific source identity retained] authorship and execution scope.
